methodology: Preliminary per-ayah screening; checked main and prior PR #261 checkpoint, #258 merged Stories work, and #93 RLS concern. No critical edition or original-language collation; all parallels mentioned are research leads, not verified associations. Do not publish.

records.topic: The earthquake overtakes the opponents of Shuʿayb
records.notes: Exodus 19:18 (earthquake at Sinai) is only a general theophany motif; no evidence of a Midianite catastrophe or textual dependence.

records.topic: Opponents of Shuʿayb become the losers
records.notes: Formula of judgment and loss; no distinctive earlier account identified in this pass.

records.topic: Shuʿayb turns away and laments his rejected counsel
records.notes: Compare prophetic lament and rejection genres only after checking primary text; do not equate biblical Jethro with Shuʿayb without independent evidence.

records.topic: God tests towns receiving prophets with hardship and adversity
records.notes: Amos 4:6–11 describes repeated calamities and failure to return to God; thematic comparison, not matching sequence or historical dependence.

records.topic: Hardship replaced by prosperity and people deny divine intervention
records.notes: Amos 4:6–11 has repeated warning calamities but not this prosperity transition; contrast should be retained.
